notes.title: ANIME STANDING finally coming soon!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/16Sqycb.gif

Hello everyone,

Hope you're all doing well during these times.

Our apologies for a long silence in releasing the game! Anime Standing was a long awaited project, which release date we had to postpone for quite a while, unfortunately. 

Regardless, we are now happy to inform that we are currently on a stage of working on fine details. And we have already sent the game for a review. It is now better, more grand and complex!

Despite how long it’d been, we plan to release Anime Standing on 1st of May. It’s only just a little more time before the game will be finally available!

Add the game to your Steam Wishlist and leave your feedback!

Stay safe,
Konnichiwa Games

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1253870/ANIME_STANDING/

notes.title: Hentai Sniper: Update#1
notes.content:
There are a couple of good news we wanted to share with you today! The work on our new game Hentai Sniper is going strong: we are adding, changing and improving the thing!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36141623/2ef85078fd1b7b078cf4311ded306128ec1a668b.png

Here are a few example of what we've achieved thus far:

 without a proper watch the terrorists grew significantly in their variety
 see your name in a freshly added leaderboard.. if you up to a challenge, that is.
 we've added the mouse sensitivity settings: no more uncontrollable movements
 You can press "SHIFT" and you’ll be able to hold your breath and aim much better
 added STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS


Hentai Sniper is now 40% OFF, do not miss the chance to succeed at the mission while the deal is still standing!

Please leave your reviews and comment your wishes in our Community. 

Let's make Hentai better!

Cheers,
Konnichiwa Games
